incident-bot: PAGE — P1: smart-routing / policy-engine runtime exceptions affecting fallback/routing decisions. Detected spike in request errors and routing oscillation. Paging @alice (oncall) and eng-runtime team. Incident id: INC-2026-034.

alice (oncall): Acknowledged. Joining. Can someone paste the top error?

ben (eng-runtime): Seeing repeated panics in policy-eval service. Sample stack: ```
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
  /service/policy/eval.go:342 main.evaluateRule
  /service/policy/server.go:128 handleRequest
```

ben (eng-runtime): Root cause looks like invalid expression evaluation when some keys are missing (variant is null in a subset of requests). Expression: `region == "eu" && variant == "v2"` — initial guess: the engine isn't null-safe for `==` comparisons against missing values in the current VM.

carla (sre-oncall): What's the customer impact? Any evidence of routing loops or wrong model variants being served?

dave (support): Several customers in EU reported higher error rates and some sessions getting older model variants instead of the pinned one. Support tickets: TCK-421, TCK-422 mention 504s and occasional mismatch (requested rw-quant-2, got rw-legacy).

ben (eng-runtime): Logs show toggling policy-eval results for identical requests. This causes smart-router to flip between routes: if a policy crashes, router falls back to region fallback rule which then re-invokes policy once the crash passes, creating a loop. Example trace: ```
2026-03-15T10:12:02Z request id=abc policy-eval: error nil ptr -> fallback to us-west
2026-03-15T10:12:02Z router: route -> us-west rw-legacy
2026-03-15T10:12:03Z request id=abc policy-eval: success -> route -> eu rw-quant-2
2026-03-15T10:12:03Z router: re-route -> eu rw-quant-2 (mismatch observed in client session)
```

ben (eng-runtime): So two problems: 1) policy-eval should never panic on missing fields, it should evaluate to false/unknown; 2) router needs to avoid re-evaluating the same policy mid-flight causing oscillation.

alice (oncall): Immediate mitigation: 1) disable the offending policy so router uses a static fallback for the affected route; 2) set a conservative static route for EU traffic to rw-legacy to stop churn; 3) escalate fix to runtime team. I'll take actions 1+2 now.

alice (oncall): Running: `redwoodctl policies disable --id=policy-9087 --env=prod`

alice (oncall): Setting fallback: `redwoodctl routing set-fallback --scope=region:eu --model=rw-legacy --ttl=15m`

alice (oncall): `deploy-bot`: policy policy-9087 disabled (ok). routing fallback for region:eu set to rw-legacy (ok). :white_check_mark:

dave (support): After config change, customer error rates dropping. Aggregated metric: 504 errors for EU reduced from 11.7% -> 1.1% in ~6 minutes. Still watching.

ben (eng-runtime): Starting a hotfix branch to guard the expression evaluator and return false on null/invalid operands. PR: https://git.internal/repo/policy-eval/pulls/789 (WIP). Will roll to canary in 10m. Patch includes: ```
if operand == nil { return false }
```

ellen (product): Noted. We'll prepare a short customer update template. Which customers were impacted most?

dave (support): Priority customers: AcmeCorp, FinMate, HealthApp. AcmeCorp had repeated session mismatches; FinMate saw increased latency and 504s.

carla (sre-oncall): On-call handoff note — I'm taking over active pager in 25m. Alice please DM any outstanding runbook steps. I'll keep the mitigation in place and monitor for 30m after the canary.

alice (oncall): Handing off to @carla. Key items: 1) ensure policy-9087 remains disabled until runtime patch lands and is validated; 2) monitor router re-eval counters and err_rate; 3) coordinate customer comms with support/product.

ben (eng-runtime): Canary deployed to 2% traffic at 10:33Z. Initial signs: policy-eval no longer panicking for null variant cases. Sample log: `policy-eval: request id=def evaluate->false (null-safe)`.

dave (support): Customer-facing note draft: "We experienced a routing policy evaluation issue that caused increased errors and occasional model mismatches for EU traffic. We've applied a mitigation and are rolling a fix; we're monitoring and will follow up." Ready for review.

carla (sre-oncall): Monitoring metrics: reroute_count down 92%, 504s trending to baseline. Keeping fallback in place until we have 10m of steady canary + no panics.

ben (eng-runtime): Rolling full deploy now — PR merged, releasing 10:48Z. Release notes: null-safe evaluator, guardrails for invalid expressions, extra telemetry for expr errors.

alice (oncall): Confirming: policy-9087 remains disabled. Once carla gives thumbs-up after 10m steady, we'll re-enable with stricter tests or replace with a corrected rule.

ellen (product): Please assign a postmortem owner and include customer impact summary and timelines. Also, update runbook to include `disable -> static fallback` as a short mitigation path.

carla (sre-oncall): Postmortem owner assigned: ben (eng-runtime). I'll coordinate incident timeline and oncall notes. Handoff complete. :handshake:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-034 resolved to mitigation state at 10:56Z. Customers continue to be monitored. Severity reduced to P2; follow-up postmortem required.
